findings.evidence: docs/threat-model.md would cite identifiers it never defines. AB11's Mitigation cell reads 'Accepted consequence of ADR 0020 (RR1)'. TB9 cites '(Q8, RR8)'. The note under the table cites '(RR9, Q9)'. AB4 and AB12 say 'the first/second bead of 5.8'. The section 5.1 outline has no residual-risk section, the threat model has no section 5.8, and its section 7 names only Q3, Q7, Q8 and Q9. So RR1, RR8, RR9 and '5.8' point at the plan file, not at anything a reader of the committed document can follow. The person working p9-authz-sweep (jade-sio), who walks every abuse case in this document, cannot find what RR1 means. The numbers also collide: the threat model's 'Q9' (code in browser history) and the README's open question 9 (freeze date, added by ADR 0022) are different questions with the same number.
findings.fix: Write the cited residual risks (RR1, RR2, RR8, RR9) out in full in the threat model's section 7, or replace each RR or Q citation with the sentence it stands for. Replace 'the first/second bead of 5.8' with 'filed by jade-okb'. Number the threat model's own questions apart from the README's open questions (for example 'TM-Q3'), or say in section 7 that they are separate from docs/adr/README.md's list.

The section 5.7 list of items for Mike names only Q3, Q7, Q8 and Q9, and the README's open questions are DECISIONS.md items 1-8 plus the freeze date. A possible conflict with rule 2 would then be raised only in the plan, not in the committed docs, although Q1 claims otherwise.
